messages:
Emma: Drafting an 'affinity shielding' proposal — basically tenant -> regional lane mapping with isolation guarantees.
Emma: Primary asks we heard from customers: region pinning, lane-level SLAs, audit logs + KMS, and a safe migration path.
Jordan: For launch gates I'd break it into infra, ops, product: infra = route API + policy editor; ops = evacuation runbook + rehearsals; product = pilot acceptance & console UX.
Priya: Pilot acceptance metrics suggestion: p95 latency < 70ms for SLA lane, failover RTO < 5m, migration success rate 100% for test tenants, and no audit gaps.
Marco: Cost constraint: reserved SLA lane should not exceed ~2.5x token cost vs pooled for our baseline prompt mix. Need concrete econ sims.
Yun: Model compatibility note: we need a manifest of supported quantizations per model. fallback rule: same family, lower-precision allowed but only after quality regression checks.
infra-bot: Perf sims kicked off for EU/US mixes. ETA: summary by EOD Thu.
Emma: Canary plan idea: ramp new lane to 5% traffic, validate latency/econ/quality via our eval suite (customer prompt set).
Jordan: Ops checklist: circuit breakers, per-tenant throttles during migration, telemetry (per-lane token cost, p50/p95/tail), and automated rollback triggers.
Priya: Compliance: pilot must include an audit-export demo and a KMS rotation test; legal to confirm acceptance criteria.
Marco: Dependencies callout: dedicated capacity pools, routing rules engine, policy precedence semantics, console policy editor, and per-lane billing metering.
Yun: I'll produce the compatibility matrix and a sample policy YAML for the RFC.
Yun: sample policy YAML (inline):
```yaml
match: tenant_id: "acme"
prefer_lane: sla_eu
fallback: pooled_global
constraints:
  - region: eu-west-1
  - model_family: gptx
```
Emma: Timeline: RFC by Mon, pilots start in ~6 weeks, GA after two successful pilots + ops signoff.
infra-bot: Reminder: attach proto diagrams and sims to the RFC: https://go/redwood/rfc-checklist
Jordan: Adding section owners on the product board. tagging @Priya @Yun @Marco for infra/compat/econ.
Emma: Policy UX review Thurs 11am — drop agenda items in doc. :rocket:
_notes: Product thread: long-term routing & multi-region tenant isolation. Contains pilot criteria, policy samples, and ops reminders. Kept concise in Slack style.
